notFound.title: There is no page here
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have been renamed.

boundary.title: This page stopped working
boundary.body: Something in the interface failed while drawing this page. What went wrong is in the browser console; nothing has been sent anywhere.
boundary.notAnAbstention: This is the interface breaking, not the product declining to answer. No question was searched and no answer was withheld.

offline.title: This device is not connected
offline.body: Pages already open still work. Anything that needs the service — asking a question, opening a source passage — will wait until you are back.

record.notAuthority: Filed or granted record — evidence of what was filed, not a statement of law. Snapshot {{date}}.

reasons.high: Based on {{passages}} passages from {{documents}} current sources.
reasons.moderateSingleDocument: Based on {{passages}} passages, all from one source.
reasons.moderateOutOfWindow: Based on {{passages}} passages, one of which sits outside its effective window.
reasons.moderateThin: Based on {{passages}} passages from {{documents}} sources — fewer than a confident answer needs.
reasons.moderateProvenancePending: Based on {{passages}} passages; at least one source is awaiting provenance review.
reasons.lowWeak: The {{passages}} passages found are weak matches for this question.
reasons.lowContradiction: The passages found disagree with each other.
reasons.abstainNothing: {{passages}} passages considered; none cleared the threshold.
reasons.abstainScope: No sources were searched — the question is outside the corpus.
reasons.abstainConflict: {{passages}} passages considered; two of them are in tension.
reasons.abstainStale: {{passages}} passages considered; all of them outside their effective window.
reasons.abstainFacts: {{passages}} passages considered; which of them governs depends on the product type.
reasons.abstainLanguage: The question was not in English, and no translation service is configured, so the sources could not be searched. Ask in English, or ask an administrator to configure translation.
